parameters.name: CreationCategory
parameters.description:
The cluster edition. Valid values:
- Normal: Cluster Edition.
- Basic: Single Node Edition.
- ArchiveNormal: Archive Database.
- SENormal: Standard Edition.
- NormalMultimaster: Multi-master Cluster.

parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description: The cluster ID. Required for non-BUY scenarios.

parameters.name: DBNodeClass
parameters.description: The node specifications. Required for the BUY scenario. Example format: polar.mysql.x4.large.

parameters.name: DBNodeIds
parameters.description: The list of node IDs to delete. Used when ModifyType is set to DELETE.

parameters.name: DBNodeNum
parameters.description: The number of nodes. Valid for the BUY scenario. This value includes the read/write node. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: DBNodes
parameters.description: The list of heterogeneous specification change nodes. Used for specification change scenarios to specify the target specifications for each node.

parameters.name: DBType
parameters.description: The database engine type. Required for the BUY scenario. Valid values: MySQL, PostgreSQL, and Oracle.

parameters.name: DBVersion
parameters.description: The database engine version. Required for the BUY scenario. Valid values for MySQL: 5.6, 5.7, and 8.0. Valid values for PostgreSQL: 11 and 14. Valid values for Oracle: 11 and 14.

parameters.name: HotStandbyCluster
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the hot standby cluster. Valid values:
- ON: Enable.
- OFF: Disable.

Valid for the BUY and specification change scenarios.

parameters.name: ModifyType
parameters.description:
The specification change direction. Valid values:
- ADD: add nodes.
- DELETE: remove nodes.
- UPGRADE: upgrade specifications.
- DOWNGRADE: downgrade specifications.
- HOT_STANDBY: hot standby change.
- STORAGE: storage space change.
- STORAGE_TYPE: storage type change.

parameters.name: OrderType
parameters.description:
The order type. Valid values:
- BUY: new purchase.
- CONVERT: billing method conversion.
- RENEW: renewal.
- UPGRADE: upgrade specifications or add nodes.
- DOWNGRADE: downgrade specifications or remove nodes.

parameters.name: PayType
parameters.description:
The billing method. Required for the BUY and CONVERT scenarios. Valid values:
- Prepaid: subscription.
- Postpaid: pay-as-you-go.

parameters.name: Period
parameters.description:
The subscription cycle. Valid values:
- Month: monthly.
- Year: yearly.

parameters.name: ProvisionedIops
parameters.description: The provisioned IOPS. Used for the Standard Edition (SENormal) scenario.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID.

parameters.name: ServerlessType
parameters.description: The serverless type. Valid values: AgileServerless.

parameters.name: StorageChargeType
parameters.description:
The storage billing type. Valid values:
- Prepaid: subscription.
- Postpaid: pay-as-you-go.

parameters.name: StorageSpace
parameters.description: The storage space, in GB. Used for prepaid storage or storage specification change scenarios.

parameters.name: StorageType
parameters.description:
The storage type. Valid values:
- PSL5: high performance.
- PSL4: standard.
- ESSDPL0
- ESSDPL1
- ESSDPL2
- ESSDPL3
- ESSDAUTOPL

parameters.name: UsedTime
parameters.description: The subscription duration. Used together with Period. Valid for the BUY, CONVERT, and RENEW scenarios when the billing method is Prepaid.

parameters.name: ZoneId
parameters.description: The zone ID. We recommend that you specify this parameter for the BUY scenario.
